value.body: A science degree in the Earth: minerals and rocks, fossils, structural geology, stratigraphy, economic geology and groundwater, with regular field trips and mapping. It is usually studied with Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics. Most geologist jobs expect a master's, so many graduates go on to an M.Sc in Geology or Applied Geology.

items.label: Course length
items.note: 4 years for Honours / Honours with Research under the UGC four-year UG framework (NEP 2020)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 in the science stream, usually with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology. Central universities admit through CUET-UG; many state universities and colleges admit on Class 12 merit or a state test.

value.title: At a glance
items: Field training is a required and large part of the course.
An M.Sc is the usual entry level for geologist titles in companies and government.
The UPSC Combined Geo-Scientist Examination and GATE (Geology & Geophysics) are the main exam routes after an M.Sc.
Mining, exploration, groundwater and oil and gas are the main employing sectors.
